title: The Starting Price
audience: Young Ethiopians and diaspora friends, watching on phones
intent: Smile at the embarrassment, recognise their own family, remember that a price is a starting offer
style_block: warm soft hand-painted illustration, gentle grain, golden afternoon light, small Ethiopian town, no text, no letters, no numbers, vertical-friendly centred composition

character_sheet.description: a small boy about 8 years old, short black hair, yellow t-shirt, faded blue shorts, painterly illustration, shown from behind or at a distance, no detailed face
supporting: the mother: an adult woman in a cream patterned shawl, shown only from behind, in silhouette, or as hands
the shop owner: an adult man in a dark waistcoat, shown only as a silhouette or hands

music.caption: gentle warm acoustic score, soft plucked strings, light hand percussion, nostalgic, tender, no lead melody, no vocals

shots.reason: Establish the small town and the street of boutiques
shots.image_prompt: a small-town street lined with tiny boutiques, jeans and clothes hanging in the doorways, a small boy and his mother walking away from the camera
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in, soft dust in the light

narration.text: ልጅ እያለሁ እናቴ በከተማችን ወዳለው የትናንሽ ሱቆች መንገድ ወሰደችኝ።

shots.subtitle_en: When I was a kid, my mother took me to a street of small boutiques in our town.

shots.reason: The want: the boy spots the jeans
shots.image_prompt: the small boy seen from behind pointing at a pair of blue jeans hanging in a boutique doorway

narration.text: የትኛውን እንደምፈልግ ጠየቀችኝ፤ አንድ ጂንስ ሱሪ አመለከትኩ።

shots.subtitle_en: She asked which one I liked. I pointed at a pair of jeans.

shots.image_prompt: the mother seen from behind facing the shop owner in silhouette inside a small boutique, jeans on the wall
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, soft light flicker

narration.text: ባለሱቁን ስንት እንደሆነ ጠየቀችው፤ ሁለት ሺህ ብር አለ።

shots.subtitle_en: She asked the owner the price. Two thousand birr, he said.

shots.image_prompt: close-up of the mother's calm hand with a small gesture, warm light, shop counter
the small boy seen from behind near the shop door, head bowed, shoulders shrunk, bright street beyond
shots.subtitle_en: I wanted the ground to swallow me.

shots.image_prompt: the shop owner's raised open hands in a refusing gesture, silhouette, warm shop light
shots.subtitle_en: That's not possible, the owner said.

shots.image_prompt: the mother seen from behind turning toward the shop door, shawl swinging, bright street ahead
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle track following her, soft wind

narration.text: እንግዲያው ልሂድ አለች እናቴ፤ ወደ በሩም ዞረች።

shots.subtitle_en: Then I'm leaving, said my mother, and she turned to the door.

shots.reason: The price drops to 1000, she still refuses
shots.image_prompt: the shop owner in silhouette with an outstretched hand calling after the mother, who shakes her head, seen from behind

narration.text: ሺህ ብር ብሎ ጠራት፤ እሷ ግን ራሷን ነቀነቀች።

shots.subtitle_en: One thousand, he called after her. She shook her head.

shots.image_prompt: close-up of hands counting birr notes over a wooden counter, warm light, no text on the notes
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in, subtle hand movement

narration.text: መጨረሻ ላይ ግን በአምስት መቶ ብር ገዛነው።

shots.subtitle_en: In the end, we bought them for five hundred.

shots.reason: The lesson, stated by the narrator
shots.image_prompt: the small boy walking home from behind holding a paper bag, his mother beside him in silhouette, golden light on the street

narration.text: በዚያ ቀን አንድ ነገር ተማርኩ፤ ዋጋ መነሻ እንጂ ቋሚ ቁጥር አይደለም።

shots.subtitle_en: I learned something that day. A price is a starting offer, not a fixed number.
